title: French-Inspired Thai Curry Potatoes
description: A fusion dish combining the flavors of France and Thailand, with tender potatoes in a rich and creamy curry sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the cubed potatoes and sauté for 5-7 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add the luscious curry, thai red curry paste, and vegetable broth to the skillet.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and let cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the coconut milk and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
Enjoy your delicious French-inspired Thai curry potatoes!
Refrigerate or freeze leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat in the oven or microwave until hot and steamy.
